jobs.title: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description: Employer career level: Early Professional. Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in electronic design automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop new and highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics in order to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board and system design. We are currently looking for a talented Application Engineer to join our team in Cairo, Egypt. Position Overview The Application Engineer role is a customer-facing position that helps drive Siemens EDA Custom IC (CIC) circuit design and simulation technologies, with emphasis on Solido products, the world's leading tools for variation-aware design and characterization of standard cell, memory, and analog/RF designs. This position combines technical depth in circuit design, verification, and applications knowledge (e.g., transceivers, RFIC, high-speed I/O, and signal conditioning), as well as solid communication skills, previous organization management experience including leading technical sales teams, and strong team building skills. The Application Engineer manages multiple customer engagements concurrently and must be very effective at customer relationships. This customer interface is not only at the engineering level, but first or second level management, as well. The Application Engineer must align with Account Managers to exceed quota, as they proactively manage customer accounts to success. This could include account planning and developing solutions to customer problems, ultimately resulting in revenue. Success involves working as a team with sales, marketing, and R&D organizations. Sales and support responsibilities include assessing customer technical requirements, conducting product demonstrations, running evaluations, and driving product adoption. The successful candidate must be able to travel (at least 25%) to cover multiple accounts. Key Responsibilities An Application Engineer for the Custom IC field team, you work with account teams to drive adoption of Siemens EDA IC design and simulation software. This includes, but is not limited to, the following activities: Execute      both pre-sale and post-sale technical support activities including      assessment of how company products meet customer needs and the preparation      of product specifications for development and installation of customized      applications/solutions. Illustrate      the value Siemens EDA brings to customers by assisting them in their      evaluations of our Custom IC Design and Analog Mixed Signal family of      software; developing and delivering software demonstrations and technical      presentations; performing benchmark evaluations for customers. Work      closely with area sales management, account teams and customers to      understand business opportunities. Establish      and maintain lines of communication with design engineering on issues such      as considerations for product reliability. Work      with R&D, marketing, and product managers to define new products and      provide insight from the field back to these groups. jobs.title: Sr.Testing & Quality Control Engineer @ Siemens Factory
jobs.description: Employer career level: Experienced Professional. Senior Testing & Quality Control Engineer - Egypt/Cairo Siemens strongly believes in the value of a Digital Portfolio, hence Smart Infrastructure combines Digital Power Distribution and Digital Building Infrastructure technologies. Our Digital Portfolio will enable our customers to enjoy occupant’s intuitive buildings which are comfortable, safe, secure and energy efficient. Join our Smart Infrastructure Electrification and Automation Business Unit as a Senior Testing & Quality Control Engineer and help us re-imagine the world by ensuring safe, reliable and high-quality switchgear solutions for our customers. Your Role - International, Challenging and Future-Oriented! In this role, you will join our Electrification & Automation plant team in Egypt/Cairo and take a senior, hands-on role in switchgear testing and quality control. You will be responsible for executing electrical and functional tests, operating measuring and test equipment, evaluating results, identifying nonconformities and confirming product compliance before release. Your main responsibilities will include: · Personally perform and lead routine, functional and electrical testing of low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear, control panels, protection panels and related assemblies in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, test procedures and applicable standards. · Demonstrate strong hands-on capability in safely preparing test setups; connecting, configuring and operating electrical measuring and test equipment; and interpreting results. This is a core requirement of the role. · Operate equipment such as primary and secondary current-injection test sets, protection-relay test systems, AC high-voltage withstand (hipot) testers, insulation-resistance testers, micro-ohmmeters, earth-continuity testers, digital multimeters, clamp meters, phase-sequence meters, calibrated torque tools and thermal-imaging cameras. · Perform protection-relay testing, trip-circuit verification, electrical and mechanical interlocking checks, circuit-breaker timing and operation checks, CT/VT circuit verification, control-logic and wiring checks, metering checks, communication checks and functional simulation of switchgear operating sequences. · Perform insulation-resistance, dielectric-withstand, contact-resistance, continuity, polarity, phase-sequence, mechanical-operation, torque, visual and dimensional inspections, as applicable to the product and approved inspection and test plan. · Prepare test setups, select the appropriate ranges and accessories, verify equipment condition and calibration status, apply safe isolation and grounding practices, and ensure accurate recording and traceability of measured values. · Review approved single-line diagrams, schematic and wiring diagrams, bills of materials, customer specifications, inspection and test plans, and acceptance criteria before starting testing activities. · Identify, contain and document product or process nonconformities; issue and follow up nonconformance reports; support root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions; and verify effectiveness before closure. · Plan and coordinate factory acceptance tests with customers, consultants, project teams and other stakeholders, ensuring professional test execution, complete test evidence and timely resolution of observations. · Develop and maintain test procedures, checklists, inspection records, test certificates, equipment logs, calibration records and final quality documentation with full product traceability. · Ensure that testing and inspection activities comply with applicable IEC standards, including IEC 61439, IEC 62271, IEC 60947 and IEC 60255, as relevant to the product, as well as Siemens internal quality and product-safety requirements. · Analyze recurring test failures and quality trends, provide technical feedback to Engineering and Production, and drive practical improvements to reduce defects, rework and testing lead time. · Guide and coach testing technicians and junior engineers on test methods, equipment operation, result interpretation, troubleshooting, documentation and safe working practices. · Maintain the readiness and proper control of the testing area, test benches, measuring instruments, accessories and reference standards, and coordinate calibration, maintenance and repair when required. · Apply all EHS requirements for electrical testing, including risk assessment, lockout/tagout, restricted test areas, warning signs, personal protective equipment, safe discharge and emergency arrangements. Your Qualifications and Skills - Digital and Solid! · Bachelor's degree in Electrical Power Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. · 7-10 years of relevant experience in switchgear testing and quality control within a manufacturing, panel-building or industrial environment. · Proven, recent hands-on experience in independently performing switchgear tests and personally operating electrical measuring and test equipment is mandatory. Purely supervisory, documentation-based or theoretical experience does not satisfy this requirement. · Strong practical knowledge of LV and/or MV switchgear, circuit breakers, protection relays, CTs/VTs, control circuits, interlocking schemes, busbar systems and panel wiring. · Ability to independently prepare a test setup, select suitable instruments, connect equipment safely, execute tests, evaluate readings against acceptance criteria, troubleshoot failures and issue complete test records. · Working knowledge of applicable IEC standards, test procedures, calibration control, measurement traceability, inspection and test plans, nonconformance management, root-cause analysis and corrective-action methods. · Experience in supporting or leading customer-witnessed factory acceptance tests and resolving technical observations during FAT activities. · Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, schematic diagrams, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, protection settings and product documentation. · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a disciplined approach to safety, accuracy and documentation. · Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and digital reporting tools; experience with electronic test-reporting or quality-management systems is an advantage. · Excellent command of Arabic and English. What else do you need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced engineering technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant, that benefits society and human progress. jobs.title: Senior Procurement Professional @ Siemens Egypt
jobs.description: Employer career level: Experienced Professional. Job Title: Senior Procurement Professional Location: Cairo, Egypt About Siemens: At Siemens, we're committed to making real what matters. We are a global technology powerhouse focusing on electrification, automation, and digitalization. As a leader in sustainable solutions, we empower our customers to transform their industries and create a better future. In Egypt, Siemens plays a pivotal role in developing critical infrastructure, from power generation and transmission to smart industrial solutions. What you'll do: As a Project Procurement Manager, you will be a key player in our project lifecycle, integrating procurement strategies and activities from the earliest sales phases through project execution. Your mission will be to maximize our contribution to operating results by strategically managing procurement and purchasing activities, ensuring optimal product/service availability, quality, and adherence to Siemens' global procurement standards. You will be instrumental in optimizing resource deployment and fostering strong supplier relationships. Your Responsibilities: Early Project & Sales Engagement: Integrate procurement into the project management process and project teams from the early sales phase. Proactively review and monitor the sales funnel (e.g., Philos) to ensure timely and effective Procurement involvement. Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners and participate in project/sales meetings to provide critical procurement market insights and preferred supplier information, optimizing supplier selection and internal workflows. Support project calculations with reliable and up-to-date cost data, contributing to increased bid success rates. Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management: Develop and implement project-specific procurement strategies in alignment with Business Unit and company-wide objectives, leveraging pooling opportunities and master contracts. Establish and maintain Preferred Supplier Lists (FPL), conduct thorough supplier qualifications, project-specific evaluations, and drive supplier development activities. Identify and integrate supplier innovations and preferred product portfolios to enhance Siemens' cost position and customer benefit. Analyze the scope of supply, contractual obligations, and precisely understand customer's functional needs to inform sourcing decisions. Negotiation & Contract Management: Lead contractual and price negotiations or provide expert support to specialist buyers for specific material fields, to secure project targets with optimum conditions, focusing on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Conduct eSourcing activities effectively. Ensure that procurement risks, changes to the original scope of supply, and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are comprehensively covered in valid contracts. Mitigate Siemens' risk exposure by ensuring that contractual obligations towards the customer, which must be fulfilled by suppliers, are properly addressed. Risk Management & Project Control: Identify and proactively manage particular procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims, and market forces throughout the entire project lifecycle, in collaboration with Commodity Management. Establish and control all Procurement resources and activities within the project, ensuring adherence to budget, availability, and quality targets. Apply Siemens Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organizational standards, and internal guidelines. Clarify internal indicators for project controlling and compile all relevant information to submit qualified reports (e.g., for the project team, Procurement management), proactively ensuring resource availability, status transparency, and alerting on deviations. Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement: Systematically forward all relevant Procurement information (e.g., updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross-functional partners up to date. Sensitize cross-functional partners to procurement-related practices, processes, and metrics, fostering a culture of procurement awareness. What you'll need to succeed: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering is a must. Proven experience in project procurement, strategic sourcing, or a related field, preferably within the energy, infrastructure, or industrial sectors. Strong knowledge and understanding of: Medium Voltage Switchgear (AIS) based on IEC standards. Low Voltage Panels & Devices. Protection & Control Systems, including a basic understanding of protection relays. Substation Automation Systems (SAS), with familiarity in communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, and Profibus. General understanding of control panels, gateways, RTUs, and their integration with SCADA systems. Basic Power System Understanding. Panel Fabrication & Assembly processes. Exceptional negotiation and contract management skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels. Strategic thinking with a focus on cost optimization, value creation, and risk mitigation. Proactive, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment. Proficiency in procurement tools and systems (e.g., SAP Ariba, eSourcing platforms, Philos). Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required; Arabic proficiency is a strong plus. We offer you 2 to 3 days of mobile work per week as a global standard. Diverse and inclusive culture. We are seeking a detail-oriented Trade Compliance Analyst to support second line sanctions screening activities by validating and investigating escalations from first line screening. This position plays a vital role in strengthening the compliance framework, mitigating risk, and ensuring adherence to global sanctions and export control regulations.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

## About this Role

We are seeking a PMO Analyst to join the Vodafone UK D&IT Delivery team during an exciting period of transformation and growth. This role sits within a dynamic functional operating model, partnering with portfolio teams to maintain delivery standards, strengthen governance practices, and promote continuous improvement across project delivery.  
The successful candidate will work closely with Technology Delivery teams, PMO Leads, Value & Execution Leads, and Senior Management to support the effective planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting of projects and programmes. They will play a key role in ensuring projects are governed effectively, resourced appropriately, financially managed, and delivered through a robust assurance framework aligned to organisational standards and hybrid delivery principles.

## What you’ll do

Collaborate with the Value & Execution Lead and PMO Leads to support the successful planning, execution, and monitoring of projects and programmes.  
Maintain and optimise project management processes, standards, and governance practices while championing a culture of continuous improvement.  
Ensure Technology Delivery milestones are accurately tracked and maintained within approved systems.  
Monitor and maintain project risks, issues, dependencies, and actions, escalating where appropriate.  
Support the adoption of hybrid delivery approaches and promote alignment with SAFe principles and values.

jobs.title: Last Mile - Area Manager ( Cairo )
jobs.description: About us :- Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience altogether to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions. The role oversees courier capacity, fleet optimization, backlog control, and cost efficiency while maintaining a high-quality delivery experience. It also involves leading and developing hub teams, analyzing performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency and merchant satisfaction. Job Duties:- : • Own hub-level ASR (Attempt Success Rate), DSR, and Delivery Promise across the assigned area; set and deliver weekly targets. • Monitor daily performance dashboards and lead root-cause analysis whenever a KPI slips. • Manage COD delivery execution and reduce failed and fake delivery attempts. • Plan courier capacity against volume and keep load per courier (OFD/courier) within a healthy, sustainable range. Balance the fleet mix (motorcycles vs. vehicles) to volume, geography, and parcel profile. Backlog & Aging Control • Keep forward backlog and parcel aging within SLA; coordinate overflow across hubs when demand spikes. • Drive down fake attempts, wrong-zoning, not-found, and lost/damaged parcels. • Enforce exception-handling, scanning, and dispatch discipline across all hubs. • Own cost-per-package for the area; manage courier contract rates and right-size structural capacity. • Lead, coach, and develop hub leads and supervisors; build a performance-driven culture. • Partner with Mid-Mile, Tech, Fulfillment, Quality, and Commercial teams to resolve cross- functional issues and protect merchant experience. • Produce clear, data-driven weekly performance reviews for leadership Job Requirements:- : Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field. • 4+ years in last-mile, logistics, or field operations, including 2+ years leading teams. • Strong data literacy — confident with Excel, dashboards, and operational metrics. • Proven fleet / courier management and capacity-planning experience. • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills. • Fluent Arabic; good written and spoken English. • Based in Greater Cairo and able to travel across assigned hubs.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Alpha isn’t a chatbot sitting on top of a product. It’s an agent that reads a customer’s account, reasons about their plan, and prepares real orders for them to confirm. The model is the easy part. The hard part is everything around it: the tools it calls, the context it sees, how a request gets routed, the guardrails that keep it away from anything that must be exact, and the deterministic systems underneath that place orders, move money and consume events. You’ll own parts of that system end to end, from spec to production. When something goes wrong in a conversation, you’ll be the one who opens the traces and finds where the run went wrong. You’ll decide whether the fix belongs in a tool, a prompt, the routing, the backend or the model, and prove it with an eval. Then you’ll explain it so product, design and other squads can act on it. Much of the work crosses squads. Alpha integrates with Thndr’s order, funding, savings and market-data services, so you’ll write proposals other teams adopt as well as code. We also work with served models beyond Alpha, so some of the work goes below the API: choosing, evaluating, fine-tuning and serving models for other Thndr products. We work through coding agents every day. We expect you to be very good at running your own and at helping others fix their workflows. This is an R&D role, and we hire for breadth on purpose. Most of your time goes to Alpha, but the same person who fixes a routing failure on Monday might be benchmarking an open model, prototyping an agent for another squad, or testing whether a new technique is worth adopting by Friday. We expect you to pick up unfamiliar problems quickly, take them from research to something running in production, and know when an experiment should stop. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own parts of Alpha end to end. Take a module, such as a tool family, the evaluation pipeline or an integration, and be accountable for how it behaves, its quality in production, and its long-term health. Don’t just follow the design we have: change it when it’s wrong. • Design the harness. Tool contracts that read as the model’s instructions, context the model can use, routing between capabilities, and guardrails that move must-have rules out of prompt text and into code. Start from the behaviour a customer needs and work back to the component. • Build observability and evaluation that people trust. Read traces before building dashboards. Categorise real failures and fix the most upstream one first. Build evals that check the resulting state, not just the final message. Validate LLM judges against human labels. Know the noise floor before calling something a win or a regression. • Run Alpha like a production service. Own latency, reliability and cost for your area: time to first token, end-to-end turn latency, streaming, provider rate limits and fallbacks, and cost per conversation. Set the budgets, monitor them, and get paged when they break. • Engineer the deterministic parts properly. Retrieval, event consumers that drive automated execution, planning and allocation logic, and integrations with money-moving services, with idempotency, retries and reconciliation. What we do in the next year decides how big this gets. The people who join now will own a piece of it and be paid well for it. If that's what you've been looking for, I'd love to meet you. Yasser Elsaid, CEO

Role Profile: We are seeking a highly skilled Digital Energy System Architect to lead the design and development of integrated Smart Building solutions across the Middle East & Africa. The role focuses on Building Management Systems (BMS), Guest Room Management Systems (GRMS), Fire Detection & Alarm Systems, Security & Access Control Systems, and Building IoT platforms. As a trusted technical expert, you will work closely with customers, consultants, sales teams, and delivery organizations to develop scalable, secure, and future-ready architecture that enable intelligent, sustainable buildings, that align with Schneider Electric’s strategic objectives. Role Responsibilities: Design end-to-end Smart Building architectures involving: Building Management Systems (BMS) Guest Room Management Systems (GRMS) Fire Detection & Alarm Systems Access Control & Video Surveillance Systems Energy Management & Building IoT platforms Define system integration strategies using open protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, KNX, OPC UA, MQTT, and REST APIs. Conduct technical workshops with customers, consultants, and project stakeholders. Support bid preparation, compliance reviews, technical proposals, and solution presentations. Ensure cybersecurity, interoperability, scalability, and adherence to industry standards. Act as the technical authority for complex Smart Building solutions across multiple verticals including hospitality, commercial buildings, healthcare, data centers, airports, and smart cities. Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Automation, Computer, or related Engineering discipline. 10+ years of experience in Smart Buildings, Building Automation, or Digital Energy solutions. Strong expertise in BMS, GRMS, Fire, Security, and integrated building systems. Experience with large-scale building projects and multi-vendor integrations. Knowledge of OT/IP networking, cybersecurity, and open building protocols. Excellent customer-facing, presentation, and technical leadership skills. jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer II
jobs.description: Who are we and what we stand for? Schneider Electric's purpose is to create Impact by empowering all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all. We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Application Engineer to join our Centre of Excellence (CoE) and lead the design, validation, and execution of advanced industrial automation solutions across the MEA Zone, with EcoStruxure Automation Expert (EAE) at the core. This position will act as a technical leader for customers, partners, sales teams, Solution Architects, and Global Delivery teams across the complete application lifecycle, from technical discovery and architecture definition through project execution, commissioning support, troubleshooting, and optimization. The role requires broad multi-vendor automation expertise across Schneider Electric, Siemens, and Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley PLC platforms, together with experience in AVEVA and other SCADA/HMI systems. The Senior Application Engineer will lead complex migrations, integration strategies, technical governance, and the development of reusable engineering standards while mentoring junior engineers and partners. What will you do? Cooperate with Sales and Solution Architects with technical strategy, application architecture, competitive differentiation, demonstrations, and solution validation to win complex automation opportunities using EAE. Lead technical discovery with customers, OEMs, System Integrators, and end users; translate machine, process, plant, and business requirements into scalable control, HMI/SCADA, networking, safety-aware, and IT/OT architectures. Own the technical execution of indirect projects with Schneider Electric partners and coordinate direct projects with Global Delivery teams across the MEA Zone, including scope, design reviews, risk management, validation, escalation, and technical acceptance. Design, review, and optimize multi-vendor automation architectures involving Schneider Electric Modicon platforms and EAE, and migration from Siemens SIMATIC/TIA Portal, and Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 platforms. Lead SCADA/HMI architecture, integration, and migration activities using AVEVA System Platform, AVEVA Plant SCADA, AVEVA Edge, EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert, and comparable third-party SCADA platforms where required. Lead competitor migration assessments from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and other legacy PLC/SCADA platforms to Schneider Electric and EAE, including code analysis, I/O and communication mapping, functional conversion, testing, and risk mitigation. Conduct design audits, application assessments, Factory Acceptance Tests, performance validation, and troubleshooting for mission-critical or large-scale automation projects. Define and govern engineering standards, reusable libraries, CATs, templates, APIs, simulation/test methods, and documentation that reduce engineering effort and improve quality, scalability, and lifecycle maintainability. Lead customer workshops, roadmap discussions, POCs, demos, and technical presentations; clearly communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and business value to technical and management stakeholders. Mentor junior engineers and partners, review technical deliverables, and collaborate with the Global Teams and Lines of Business (LoB) to resolve complex application gaps and scale proven solutions. What are the key skills we are looking for? jobs.title: Senior Site Engineer
jobs.description: Schneider Electric is a global energy technology leader, driving efficiency and sustainability by electrifying, automating, and digitalizing industries, businesses, and homes. Our technologies enable buildings, data centers, factories, infrastructure, and grids to operate as open, interconnected ecosystems, enhancing performance, resilience, and sustainability. Our portfolio includes intelligent devices, software-defined architectures, AI-powered systems, digital services, and expert advisory. With 160,000 employees and one million partners in over 100 countries, Schneider Electric is consistently ranked among the world’s most sustainable companies. What will you do? The Senior Site Engineer is responsible for managing the construction of one or more sites. He/She sets up and monitors the overall organization of the sites in conjunction with the Site supervisors. He/She must comply with all the safety, quality and technical regulations and standards in force. He/She is also responsible for ensuring that the works progress smoothly in compliance with costs, deadlines and resources. He/She reports to the Head of Regional Site Teams (regularly) and reports functionally to the Operation Manager of the GCP Ops Site Works department. He/She is responsible for site record management and provides feedback at site closure. Your Role – Magic happens when you bring great people together! Schedule drafting and monitoring supervision. Ensure compliance with the project schedule. Supervise the drafting and monitoring of site schedules in conjunction with the Site Works Coordinator, if required. Validate, with the Project Manager, the objectives, costs, deadlines, resources established when the estimate was prepared and updated when the work begins in the form of an internal contract. Organize the site in compliance with the budget objectives set at the start of the project in conjunction with the Project Manager. Identify opportunities for reducing expenditure. Keep track of any discrepancies in expenditure with respect to the budget in the monthly report and explain them. Keep the NCR monitoring and opportunity & claim folder up to date. Manage the risks inherent in the site (identify them and find all the solutions required to eradicate or avoid them). Prepare the project, before work starts on the site, in conjunction with the various departments, the GCP /Ops Operation department and Site Works Coordinator, the Project Manager: Design review, contract kick off meetings, site staff mobilisation, etc. Prepare the budget quote for the internal contract in conjunction with the site works coordinator. Define the assembly methodologies with the site works coordinator and how they can be adapted to the contractual requirements of the project. Pass this work plan on to the project Site supervisors. Set up the organizational structure and the offices on the site. Comply with the site organizational requirements as defined with the Project Manager and the GCP /Ops Operation department. Manage the project in conjunction with the Site supervisor(s) (in accordance with the job specifications, the contractual terms, the Assignment order, the Quality plan, the HSE plan and the operating procedures). Accept and store the equipment and devices on site. Ensure that the site organization and the work execution procedures, tests and commissioning and all the resources used on the site(s) (buildings, containers, machines, vehicles) comply with the current legislation and the local regulations. With respect to HSE issues, He/She relies on the HSE manager on each site. Provide the Site Works Coordinator with technical support, if required. Set up a site quality plan Take all the measures required to control the products supplied by the customer and incorporated in the works and operate or ensure the operation and quality of the site(s) in accordance with the project operating procedures, folders and instructions received in order to comply with the Quality Management System. (NCR monitoring, etc.) Understand and qualify the customer's facilities in order to propose improvement works or solutions. Ensure that the monitoring, test and commissioning equipment and devices are maintained, routinely checked, calibrated, transported and delivered to the site. Ensure, in conjunction with the site and test supervisor(s), that all the operators, including the subcontractors, have updated their drawings and that when the site is finished, the site "RED MARKS" documents are sent to the Design Office to enable the final "AS BUILT" documents to be completed. Interface with the Project Manager and reporting In conjunction with the Site Works Coordinator, draw up the following documents and send them to the Project Manager and the GCP /Ops Operation department: monthly status report with discrepancy monitoring, monthly progress report, minutes of meetings, statement of damage occurring during transportation and on site, state of the equipment on arrival on site, condition of the final stocks, operating incident records, equipment incident records, non-conformance records, etc. At the end of the project, in conjunction with the Site Works Coordinator, prepare all the items required for the end-of-project assessment and feedback with the organization responsible for the contract and ensure that the annotated documents and drawings (assembly, tests, etc.) are centralized at the end of the project in order to check that they are valid before sending them to the Project Manager and to the customer, after approval by the Project Manager. Compliance with HSE requirements. Ensure that Health and safety requirements are applied at site (Local regulatons, SE directives, customer requirements). Ensure that the resources to be allocated on site, the skills, experience, accreditation level according to the nature of the work to be done are adapted. Implement, manage and update site safety plan and risk assessment related. Make sure that FSRs and Sub contractors under his/her/her responsibilty apply HSE rules. Perform site safety inspections. Conduct periodic safety meetings and manage action plans. Manage safety incidents and take immediate actions. Monitor, document, track and review safety KPI. According to the skills, means and authority, the site manager has overall responsibility for the EHS aspects on sites for which he/she is responsible. What's in it for me? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering 5 to 8 years of experience. Confirmed experience or literacy with any of Schneider Equipment for MV (Premset, MCSET, PIX), Protection Relays (SEPAM, Micom, Easergy), UPS APC Symmetra and LV Distribution panels (Blokset, Okken, Prisma) is advantage. jobs.title: Power System Studies Professional Engineer
jobs.description: The Power System Studies Expert is responsible for performing, reviewing, and validating advanced electrical power system studies for medium-voltage and low-voltage distribution networks. The role ensures that electrical systems are safe, reliable, properly protected, technically compliant, and optimized throughout tendering, design, project execution, commissioning, and operation. The expert acts as the technical reference for power system analysis and translates study results into practical engineering decisions. Key Responsibilities 1. Power System Studies Perform and review load flow and power flow studies. Perform short-circuit calculations for MV and LV systems. Conduct protection coordination, discrimination, and selectivity studies. Define and validate protection settings for circuit breakers and protection relays. Perform arc-flash hazard analysis and recommend risk-mitigation measures. Perform motor-starting studies and assess voltage-dip and network impact. Perform harmonic analysis and evaluate power-quality requirements. Verify voltage drop, cable sizing, transformer loading, and network capacity. Perform earthing and grounding studies where included in the project scope. Perform transient, dynamic, and stability studies when required by project complexity. 2. Network Modeling and Simulation Develop accurate electrical network models based on single-line diagrams, equipment data, load lists, cable data, transformer parameters, and protection information. Use ETAP or comparable industry-standard software for modeling, simulation, and technical analysis. Review models prepared by other engineers and verify assumptions, input data, study scenarios, and calculation methods. Maintain consistency between study models, equipment selections, engineering calculations, and final project documentation. 3. Key Responsibilities Data Engineering & Development Design, develop, test and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using PySpark. Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for large-volume enterprise data workloads. Develop reusable ingestion, transformation and validation frameworks. Implement data quality controls, reconciliation checks, monitoring and operational logging. Support dimensional, warehouse, data lake and lakehouse data modeling activities. Apply Spark performance optimization techniques including partitioning, join optimization, caching and handling data skew. Cloudera Platform Engineering Develop and run Spark workloads within the Cloudera Data Platform (CDP) environment. Work with components including Cloudera Data Engineering (CDE), Cloudera Data Warehouse (CDW), Hive, Impala, Ozone, Ranger, Atlas and NiFi. Configure, execute, monitor and troubleshoot Spark workloads. Performance-tune PySpark jobs, Spark configurations, SQL queries and Hive/Impala workloads. Diagnose platform, ingestion, transformation, storage and workload execution issues. Apply security, access-control, metadata and lineage practices using Ranger and Atlas. Candidates without prior Cloudera experience will be expected to complete the required Cloudera enablement/upskilling and apply their existing Spark and data engineering knowledge to the platform. Architecture, Governance & Delivery Contribute to lakehouse implementations using modern table formats such as Apache Iceberg. Apply engineering standards covering modular design, code quality, testing, version control and CI/CD. Participate in requirements analysis, solution design, technical estimation and design reviews. Support system integration testing, UAT, production deployment and operational readiness. Produce clear technical documentation and deliver structured knowledge-transfer sessions. Collaborate effectively with distributed, multicultural teams and technical and business stakeholders. Candidate Profile Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline. At least 4 years of professional experience in data engineering. At least 3 years of hands-on PySpark / Apache Spark development experience. Experience delivering large-scale enterprise data pipelines and ETL/ELT solutions. Cloudera CDP experience is an advantage, but not mandatory. Strong candidates from comparable Spark-based data platforms are encouraged to apply. Mandatory Technical Skills ✓ PySpark ✓ Apache Spark ✓ Python ✓ Advanced SQL and query optimization ✓ ETL/ELT development ✓ Data warehousing concepts ✓ Linux ✓ Git ✓ Data modeling fundamentals ✓ Experience working with large-scale enterprise data platforms Preferred / Upskillable Skills Cloudera CDP Cloudera CDE and CDW Hive and Impala Ranger and Atlas Apache Iceberg Apache NiFi and Kafka Apache Airflow Denodo and Informatica Oracle and Teradata Azure data services DevOps and CI/CD pipelines Cloudera CDP knowledge is preferred, not mandatory. The selected candidate will be provided with Cloudera enablement/upskilling where required. Preferred Domain Background Banking and financial services Digital banking platforms Customer analytics Regulatory reporting Enterprise data warehousing Data lakehouse implementation and migration programs Behavioural Competencies Strong analytical thinking and structured problem solving. Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and deliver reliably. Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team capability building. Ability and willingness to quickly learn new data platforms and technologies. Comfort working in distributed and multicultural delivery teams.

End-to-End Execution (GTM Execution) - Lead GTM readiness and execution for CVM propositions: campaign setup, creative approvals, device allocation alignment and go-live coordination. - Coordinate with analytics, IT/CRM, procurement and retail operations to ensure flawless proposition delivery. - Track campaign performance (ROI, conversion, attach rate, device penetration) and propose optimizations. 7. jobs.description: Job Description Incident Management & SOC Manager.Enterprise Security - (240001YA) Description Job Purpose  Manages and sets strategic methodologies for monitoring, detecting and responding to security incidents to reduce the security incidents effect on revenue streams, information assets, customer’s data and company’s image and reputation. Report To Position Name Manages CyberSecurity Incident Response Team (CIRT)  Manages CyberSecurity Incident Response Team (CIRT). CIRT is an expert group that handles computer security incidents.  Responsible for documenting, communicating and tracking all Cybersecurity Incidents affecting Etisalat Enterprise, Telecom, ISP, and B2B.  Owns the Cybersecurity Incident Management framework, which incorporates goals and objectives, polices, and processes to minimize business impact.  Defines, monitors, and measures the accomplishment of goals and objectives by quantifying the implementation, efficiency, and effectiveness of Cybersecurity Incident Management process, and identifying ways to enhance and automate various processes. The team will work closely Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC), Operations Team, and Information Security team to ensure tight integration and resiliency of all operations.  Benchmarks & recommends new solution for Cybersecurity Incident Management processes and technology against industry standard & latest Cybersecurity threats.  Identifies and tracks Incident Management performance measures to provide relevant performance trends & KPIs over time.  Engages with associates across enterprise including the Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC), Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), and other teams as necessary.  Develops and distributes executive-level summaries of cybersecurity incidents, which impact Etisalat assets.  Communicates deep technical cybersecurity threats & incident response operations information across the Cybersecurity division, to include Security Senior Director.  Manages the Execution of day-to-day cybersecurity Incident Management operations.  Creates dynamic CSIR team. Some of these team members can be attorneys, human resources, public relations, various IT staff with specific specializations.  Provides support to operational & cybersecurity strategy development.  Develops, follows, and maintains ‘playbooks’ for Incident Management workflows.  Identifies and enhances processes automation.  Prepares/ maintains Incident Response plan across organization.  Serves as a subject matter expert for security monitoring and incident response related knowledge domain and tools.  Prioritization of incidents based on organizational impact. Manages SOC “Security Operations Center”  The SOC Manager is responsible for the management and oversight of the Security Operations team for Cyber Security, specifically focused on monitoring, investigations, and cyber Threat intelligence.  The SOC Manager develops and implements monitoring use cases in the SIEM, manage security infrastructure components (SIEM, Resilient...), and be hands-on in managing investigations. He will also be responsible for working with all divisions within Cybersecurity, Network Security, Systems Security, IT, Technical, ISP, B2B lines of business, and third party resources as required.  Develops and administers SOC processes and reviews their application to ensure that SOC’s controls, policies, and procedures are operating effectively.  Manages team’s efforts to monitor for security events and provides first and final escalation analysis.  Provides management oversight for the identification, triage and response of events or incidents of apparent security breaches.  Produces and reviews aggregated performance metrics.  Provides first line supervision to direct reports.  Plays a significant role in long-term SOC strategy and planning, including initiatives geared towards operational excellence.  Manages the Escalation of cases to Incident Management team and provides all required data for investigation.  Leads strategic and tactical operations focused on developing, applying, and communicating a deep understanding of cyber campaign and nation state threats to protect the enterprise.  Primary responsibility for Threat Intelligence Platform workflows to help drive orchestration of cyber threat intelligence information into Security Operations Center missions.  Prioritizes actions during the detection, analysis, and containment of an incident based on organizational impact.  Leads initiatives around use case and indicator of compromise (IOC) development and support threat report production as needed.  Manages and increases the effectiveness and efficiency of the SOC, through improvements to each function as well as coordination and communication between support and business functions. Regulations and Standards Management  Responsible for ensuring that the Company’s security operations policies, procedures, and resources comply with regulatory requirements.  Routinely evaluates compliance with legal, regulatory, contractual and organizational requirements for the security of information assets.  Creates strategies plans to reach the regulation and standard requirements.  Designs security operation daily activities to keep organization comply with regulatory rules.  Ensures that Etisalat new implementations comply with security standards requirements.  Delivers reports and evidence related to operational activities to external auditors.  Presents Etisalat as a technical communication point with regulators and auditors. Security Enhancements & Quality Assurance  Facilitating goal-level creation for the broader function and working with managers to ensure the goals cascade to all workers.  Interacting with senior management/ heads/ directors for reporting security Incidents.  Identifies the need for, and implements new operational security management controls, and practices to meet changing organizational requirements.  Monitors routinely operational security management provision, taking action to address potential vulnerabilities.  Develops and implements the necessary information security operations management plans to maintain effective resilience during ongoing operations.  Manages the review cycle for security operations, taking into account information from incidents, vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, threat assessments and changes to relevant legislation and regulations.  Assesses, evaluates, enhances, and/or implements quality improvement practices, processes, procedures, or policies that have an impact on the planning activities. People Management  Manages and/or provides guidance to senior and junior members of the team.  Conducts periodic meetings with the network security operations teams and generates periodic reports.  Recommends training plan for CIRT.  Works on enhancing the engagement index.  Solves/ escalates the conflict between team members.  Solves/ escalates employees’ environmental issues.  Coordinates with different teams (IT, Technical) to ensure implementing the security requests and projects in a proper way. Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS_ESSENTIAL  University Degree in: BSC in Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer science.  Very Good Computer skills.  Very Good in Arabic and English (Reading, Writing and Oral).  Very Good knowledge of different security solutions  People & teams leadership, Coaching & Management. QUALIFICATIONS_DESIRABLE  Needs to have an in-depth knowledge of the business and the services the organization provide in order to establish security protocols.  Security Incident and problem management skills.  Follow security projects implementation lifecycle of security projects capability. EXPERIENCE_ESSENTIAL  Minimum 8 years’ Experience.  Area of experience: Security. EXPERIENCE_DESIRABLE  At least 6 years’ experience working in IP Network Security ,Systems Security ,SOC, and Incident Management in large corporate environment. CERTIFICATIONS_ESSENTIAL  Security training about information security solutions.  Different security certificates from common security vendors.  CCNA, GSEC & CISSP certifications. jobs.description: Job Description RF Planning Engineer - (220002FN) Description Job Purpose To plan the access network to ensure full indoor and outdoor coverage with competitive quality of service all over the network. jobs.title: Food Safety & Quality Technician
jobs.description: Role Objectives: The Food Safety & Quality Technician is responsible for monitoring and verifying food safety and quality standards across production activities, raw materials, equipment, and finished products. The role conducts inspections, identifies and addresses non-conformities, monitors hygiene and GMP compliance, and maintains accurate quality records to support product consistency, food safety, and continuous improvement. Roles & Responsibilities: Inspection, Testing & Standard Compliance: Inspect, test, and evaluate raw materials, in-process goods, equipment, and finished products against established technical specifications and quality benchmarks. Verify product dimensions, weight, appearance, sensory parameters, and functionality, ensuring full alignment with company standards. Follow up on all operational and manufacturing activities to ensure processes consistently meet defined quality criteria. Non-Conformity & Defect Handling: Promptly reject and quarantine any raw materials, semi-finished components, or finished products that fail to meet quality and safety expectations. Identify defects early in the manufacturing process to minimize waste, rework, and operational delays. Process Monitoring & Hygiene Enforcement: Monitor live production lines, machinery, and workplace environments to safeguard product integrity. Monitor compliance with personal hygiene, GMP, and sanitation standards across production areas and escalate non-compliance to the relevant stakeholders. Data Collection; Quality Reporting: Document all inspection, testing outcomes, and non-conformities by maintaining accurate logbooks, checklists, and digital performance records. Collect, compile, and organize operational data required by Quality Engineers and QA management for trend analysis and root-cause investigations. Training; Production Support: Guide, and raise awareness among production operators regarding quality standards, defect prevention, and hygiene practices to drive product excellence. Required Education, Knowledge, And Skills: Education: High school diploma, technical diploma, or a degree in Quality, Manufacturing, Food Science, or a related field. Experience: Prior experience in quality control, quality assurance, or inspection roles, preferably in a manufacturing or food production environment. Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with quality inspection techniques, measurement devices, testing tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, scales, testing checklists), and basic knowledge of quality management standards (GMP, HACCP, ISO 9001). Language & Computer Skills: Good command of written and spoken communication. Basic computer literacy for data entry, documentation, and generating routine inspection reports.

jobs.title: Odoo Implementer II
jobs.description: Role Objectives The Odoo Implementer II will play a crucial role in the implementation of Odoo ERP projects, working closely with clients to understand their needs and ensure successful deployment of the software. This position serves as a key intermediary between end-users and the technical team, focusing on requirement gathering, user training, and system optimization. He is also responsible for business needs analysis and training sessions. This job holder should have a few years of experience of implementation in domains like manufacturing, accounting/finance, and supply chain management. Roles & Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze their business processes and gather detailed requirements for Odoo implementation. Suggest and implement tailored solutions based on customer needs, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Supporting the implementation of the ERP solution from requirement collection and mapping, solution architecture, supporting technical development and configuration to testing and Go-Live full solution adoption. Write User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) to guide the implementation process. Clearly document gathered requirements and use ERP knowledge to define what will need configuration and which will need development (GAP analysis). Assist in the configuration of Odoo modules, ensuring they meet the specified requirements and enhance operational efficiency. Validate and verify the developed requirements according to the business logic. Demonstrate the developed requirements (GAP) to the client. Run a full testing cycle of the database before demonstrating the project to the client to ensure validity. Conduct training sessions for end-users to facilitate effective use of the Odoo system and provide ongoing support for any issues that arise. Help create and maintain project plans, ensuring timely delivery of project milestones and effective communication with stakeholders. Record, address and resolve stakeholder requests regarding Odoo issues, providing detailed solutions within agreed time frames. Actively support the clients in the going live phase. Working closely with users to assess feasibility and reflect requested workflow requirements. Defining and enforcing data policies and controls to ensure enterprise data is accurate, complete, secure, and reliable. Stay updated on Odoo features and best practices to recommend enhancements and optimizations for client systems. jobs.title: Material Control Lead

The role is accountable for inventory accuracy, BOM integrity within the MRP, daily material variance visibility, FIFO discipline, scrap control, release plan adherence, and OPEX control. The position acts as the control point between Warehouse, Production, Planning, Procurement, Quality, and Finance, ensuring that what the system reports always matches what is physically on the floor, and that no production plan is disrupted by a material issue. Roles & Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end material flow cycle across the three facilities — from the main warehouse through internal warehouses and production lines to final packaging — for every product, ensuring material availability at every stage without excess or interruption. Lead the stock count cycle across all three sites (daily/weekly cycle counts and periodic full counts); own the inventory accuracy action plan, drive root-cause analysis on every discrepancy, and track accuracy improvement against target. Own the implementation and control of all BOM updates across the MRP and the internal warehouses — validating new and revised BOMs with Production, R&D, and Costing before release, and enforcing version control consistently across the three facilities. Issue and share the daily material variance report (theoretical vs. actual consumption by SKU and material) with the relevant stakeholders in Production, Planning, Quality, and Finance, including the quantified financial value of the variance and the agreed corrective actions. Enforce FIFO/FEFO application for all materials across storage locations and line feeding — covering labeling, put-away, and picking discipline — and issue shelf-life and aging reports to prevent expiry-driven write-offs. Own the scrap-rate reduction target for materials stored in the warehouse (damage, expiry, obsolescence, and handling loss); audit reason-code accuracy and scrap trends across the three facilities, and drive corrective actions with the responsible functions. Monitor OPEX against budget, flag overruns early, and propose recovery plans to the Manager. Track release-plan adherence across the three facilities (on-time and in-full release to the lines) using shortage/delay flags raised by Material Controlling Engineers; identify recurring root causes and drive site-level and cross-site corrective actions before they impact the plan. Govern all inventory transactions in the ERP — receipts, internal transfers, returns, adjustments, and work-order consumption — ensuring every physical movement is posted accurately and same-day. Propose and maintain min/max and safety stock per material and facility, within the policy approved by the Manager Escalate impending material shortages, late deliveries, inventory shrinkage, and master-data or BOM issues to Planning and Procurement, and drive them to closure before production is interrupted. Implement and maintain the approved SOPs and KPI definitions at all three sites.. Ensure material storage, handling, and traceability comply with food safety and quality requirements (FSSC 22000 / HACCP / GMP), including lot traceability and readiness for internal and external audits. Lead, coach, and develop the material control and storekeeping teams across the three facilities, including shift coverage, training on transaction accuracy, and performance follow-up. Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems (Preferred: Odoo ERP), including BOM structures, inventory transactions, internal warehouse setup, and work-order consumption. Strong working knowledge of inventory control techniques — cycle counting, ABC classification, FIFO/FEFO, safety stock and min/max setting, and variance and root-cause analysis. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; comfortable building reports, dashboards, and reconciliations from large transaction data sets. Understanding of food safety and quality standards relevant to material storage and traceability (FSSC 22000, HACCP, GMP). Cost awareness — able to translate material variance and scrap into financial impact and to control OPEX against budget. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to hold cross-functional teams accountable across multiple sites. Willingness to travel between the three facilities and to work count- and shift-aligned cycles, including weekend or night coverage when required.

The role ensures that all processing of personal data – of millions of customers, 10,000+ employees and DAs , suppliers and partners – complies with Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 (PDPL) and its Executive Regulations, and that privacy is treated as a source of customer trust and a business enabler. The Head of Data Privacy sets the privacy governance framework, advises the CEO, Executive Committee and Board, builds and leads the privacy function. Roles & Responsibilities: Privacy Strategy, Governance & Leadership Define and own the company-wide data privacy strategy, policy framework and multi-year roadmap, approved by the Executive Committee. Establish privacy governance: Privacy Steering Committee, RACI per function, policy hierarchy, and a Privacy Champions network across all departments and sites. Advise the CEO, ExCom and Board on privacy risk, regulatory exposure and the privacy implications of strategic initiatives (new business lines, M&A, market expansion, partnerships). Build, lead and develop the privacy team; set budget, capability plan and success measures for the function. Regulatory Compliance & PDPC Relationship Act as the registered Group DPO and primary point of contact with the PDPC; maintain registrations, licences and permits required under the PDPL for Breadfast as data controller and processor. Lead the company-wide PDPL compliance programme and close gaps within the regulatory grace period of the Executive Regulations. Monitor the PDPL, Executive Regulations, PDPC decisions and adjacent regulations (e.g., Central Bank of Egypt requirements for payments/fintech, consumer protection, e-commerce and cybercrime laws) and translate them into business requirements. Represent Breadfast in PDPC inspections, inquiries and industry forums. Enterprise Data Mapping & Records of Processing Own the enterprise Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) across all functions and systems: customer app and website, CRM, marketing and loyalty, payments, ERP, HRIS/payroll, WMS/TMS, rider apps and telematics, CCTV and biometrics. Maintain data classification, with controls for sensitive personal data ( Biometrics, health/medical records, financial data, national ID data, criminal record certificates) Privacy by Design, Risk & Impact Assessments Embed privacy-by-design and by-default in the product and tech lifecycle; privacy sign-off before launch of new features, systems and data uses. Set the DPIA methodology and ensure DPIAs for high-risk processing: customer profiling and personalization, AI/ML models, marketing analytics, rider GPS tracking, workplace CCTV, biometric attendance, credit/BNPL or payments features. Maintain the enterprise privacy risk register, integrated into Breadfast’s Enterprise Risk Management framework. Customer Trust, Marketing & Data Use Ensure lawful basis, clear notices and consent management for customers across app, web, calls, and marketing channels (SMS, push, email, WhatsApp), including direct marketing consent rules under the PDPL. Govern data sharing with partners, advertisers and analytics providers; set rules for anonymization and pseudonymization of data used for analytics and AI. Own customer-facing privacy policy and cookie/tracking practices. 3.6 Employee & Workforce Privacy Partner with People & Culture on privacy for the full employee lifecycle – recruitment, onboarding, background checks, payroll, social insurance, medical data, pictures, performance and offboarding. Ensure fit-for-purpose privacy notices and training for the front-liners teams, blue-collar and outsourced workforce (clear Arabic, practical formats). Third-Party, Vendor & Cross-Border Data Management Set the third-party privacy risk framework: due diligence, data processing agreements, audits and offboarding for all processors (cloud and SaaS vendors, 3PLs, rider and manpower agencies, payment providers, marketing agencies). Govern cross-border data transfers in line with PDPL conditions and PDPC licensing/approval requirements. Data Subject Rights & Complaints Own the enterprise process for data subject requests (access, correction, erasure, objection, consent withdrawal) for customers, employees and partners, within statutory deadlines. Oversee privacy complaints and escalations, in coordination with Customer Experience, P&C and Legal. Breach Management & Information Security Partnership Own the personal data breach response plan; jointly lead incident response with the CISO/Information Security. Decide on and lead notification to the PDPC and affected data subjects within the legal timeframe (72 hours to the PDPC under the PDPL). Partner with the CISO on technical and organizational security measures, retention schedules and secure disposal across offices, sites and devices. Awareness, Culture & Assurance Design the enterprise privacy training and awareness programme, tailored by audience (ExCom, tech and product, marketing, customer service, operations, frontline workforce). Run a compliance monitoring and assurance plan; support Internal Audit and external audits; report privacy KPIs quarterly to ExCom and the Audit & Risk Committee. Required Education, Knowledge, And Skills: Education Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Systems, Computer Science or Business Administration. Master’s degree / LLM in technology, data or privacy law is a strong plus. Mandatory Regulatory Requirement (Egypt PDPL) Registered in the PDPC’s DPO Registry, at the highest category/level (Category A / Lead level), given the volume and sensitivity of the personal data Breadfast processes – or able to obtain it before appointment. Passed the PDPC-approved DPO examination required for registration. Keeps registration valid; it lasts two years and must be renewed. Supporting International Certifications (preferred, not a substitute for PDPC registration) IAPP, ISC2, PECB or ISO-accredited IAPP CIPP/E and CIPM; CIPT or FIP a plus. ISO/IEC 27701 or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor; CISA, CISM or CDPSE advantageous. The PDPC may take relevant certifications into account when assigning a DPO’s registration category. Experience 12+ years in data protection, information security, compliance or technology law, including 5+ years leading a privacy programme or function. Proven track record building an enterprise privacy programme end-to-end (governance, RoPA, DPIAs, DSRs, breach response, vendor management) in a large organisation. Experience in consumer-facing digital businesses – e-commerce, quick-commerce, retail/FMCG, telecom or fintech – with large customer databases and a large frontline workforce. Hands-on experience with Egypt PDPL compliance; strong GDPR experience; GCC privacy laws (Saudi PDPL, UAE PDPL) a plus. Experience presenting to Executive Committees and Boards, and dealing directly with regulators. jobs.title: Data Engineer - DMP, Streaming & Analytics
jobs.description: Context & Vision In 2026, writing code is no longer the primary bottleneck; managing its complexity and ensuring its reliability is. We are building a highly resilient advertising platform with a very lean, senior internal team, and we intend to keep it that way. To achieve scale without the overhead of a large engineering department, we rely on an AI-first development paradigm and a philosophy borrowed from the best large-scale open-source projects. Our code is not public, but our governance is theirs: asynchronous communication, exhaustive written documentation, explicit rules, and uncompromising quality gates. It is the only way a small team of humans and AI agents ships serious systems without accumulating technical debt. This role owns the data engine underneath the platform: the streams, segments and audiences that make advertising intelligent. The Role You will own the data and DMP layer end to end — the event streams flowing in, the segment and audience computation, and the analytical stores that feed targeting and reporting. What we hire for is judgment: the problems here are hard in the interesting way, and the interesting part is the tradeoffs you choose. 1. Hard problems, at real-time scale.Computing audiences and measurement over very large, high-velocity event streams, in near-real-time, where being right is not always the same as being exact and every choice has a real cost. We describe the problems; we expect you to bring the approach. 2. Stream-First Pipeline.Own the ingestion and processing pipeline. It is stream-first by design; you keep it that way rather than falling back to batch. 3. Segments & Audiences.Own how raw signals become targetable audiences — how they are computed, stored, refreshed, and exposed to the serving path. This is the intelligence layer of the product. 4. AI-First Delivery & Governance. We expect AI to write most of the code; you are the editor, not the typist. You specify work as explicit, self-sufficient issues, direct agentic tooling to implement, and gatekeep every diff. Schemas, data contracts and Architecture Decision Records are documented. If it is not written down, it does not exist. The Tech Environment - Data: event streaming and stream processing, relational and analytical stores. - Language: the codebase is a compiled systems language; we care more about how you reason about data than about the language you arrive with. - Domain: DMP, segments, audiences, identity, measurement. - Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes. Profile & Requirements We are looking for a data-minded engineer who frames a problem before reaching for a tool, owns correctness, and thrives in a lean, high-quality environment. This role is not suited to someone who wants a narrow, hand-fed scope inside a large team. Essential Experience - 5+ years building data or backend systems in production, with genuine ownership of a pipeline's reliability and the correctness of its output. - Depth on hard data problems— you have built things where scale, real time, or accuracy made the design non-obvious, and you can talk through the tradeoffs you chose and why. - Streaming experience and a real grasp of stream-vs-batch tradeoffs, event modelling, and schema evolution. - Comfort in a compiled systems language (Rust, Go, C++, Scala or similar). The codebase is Rust; the language is the tool, the data thinking is the skill. - Working knowledge of an analytical data store and SQL. DMP / ad-data or audience/segmentation experience is a strong plus. Core Competencies & Mindset - Judgment over recipes: you frame a data problem and its constraints before choosing an approach, and you can say when an approximate answer is the right engineering call and when it is not. - Distributed & complex systems: knowledge of, and a taste for, distributed and complex systems is very welcome. Tell us about the ones you have built or operated — what made them hard. - AI Development Lifecycle: genuine proficiency editing and validating AI-produced code, and decomposing ambiguous goals into specifications an agent can execute unattended. - Uncompromising Quality: a maniacal focus on data correctness, freshness, and reliability. A wrong number that ships is a wrong number the business trusts. - Written & Asynchronous: exceptional written communication; effective in a distributed, async environment (Paris timezone +/- 3h). - Ownership: you own your pipeline and its documentation completely, and you surface problems before they are asked about.

jobs.title: Motion designer
jobs.description: Description du poste: • 1. Conception & Production Motion Design Création et animation de contenus vidéo, motion graphics, animations 2D et éléments visuels destinés aux campagnes, aux réseaux sociaux et aux productions audiovisuelles. Conception et animation d’éléments graphiques (typographies, icônes, illustrations, transitions et effets visuels) en respectant les guidelines des marques. Réalisation d’animations 2D, de compositing et d’effets visuels (VFX) de base pour enrichir les productions vidéo. Utilisation des outils IA (Runway, Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion…) pour générer, enrichir ou optimiser des assets visuels et accélérer la production créative. • 2. Collaboration avec les équipes Production & Post-Production Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production pour intégrer les éléments motion design aux différents projets audiovisuels. Participer aux étapes de montage vidéo, d’animation, de compositing et de finalisation des contenus. Assurer la préparation, l’organisation et l’intégration des assets graphiques dans les workflows de production et de post-production. Adapter les animations et les contenus vidéo aux besoins techniques et créatifs des projets. Assurer une communication fluide avec les équipes créatives, réalisateurs, monteurs et producteurs afin de garantir la cohérence des livrables. • 3. Montage Vidéo, VFX & Optimisation des Exports Réaliser des opérations de montage vidéo, de synchronisation audio, d’étalonnage de base et de finalisation des séquences. Maîtriser les techniques de compositing et de VFX de base (tracking, keying, rotoscoping, intégration d’éléments 3D et corrections visuelles). Optimiser les paramètres d’export vidéo (codec, résolution, bitrate, format et compression) selon les besoins des équipes de production et de post-production. Préparer et livrer des fichiers vidéo adaptés aux différents usages : master files, fichiers intermédiaires, versions de validation et exports finaux. Garantir la qualité technique des livrables, en assurant leur compatibilité avec les workflows de production et de post-production. Assurer la gestion et l’optimisation des projets After Effects, Premiere Pro et autres outils de production afin de faciliter leur transfert et leur réutilisation par l’équipe. • 4. Gestion Technique & Organisation des Livrables Respecter les contraintes techniques des projets en matière de résolution, de framerate, de formats, de codecs et de spécifications de diffusion. Organiser et structurer les fichiers sources, compositions, assets graphiques et exports pour faciliter le travail collaboratif. Assurer une gestion rigoureuse des fichiers de production et des assets sur les espaces de stockage partagés et le DAM (Digital Asset Management). Préparer des projets propres, optimisés et documentés pour faciliter les reprises, les modifications et les interventions des autres membres de l’équipe. Garantir le respect des délais de production et de livraison des contenus. Profil : • Expérience en Motion Design et production audiovisuelle, idéalement dans un environnement publicitaire, média ou de production vidéo. • Maîtrise des outils Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator) et des workflows de production et de post-production. • Connaissance des techniques de montage vidéo, de compositing et de VFX (tracking, keying, rotoscoping). • Bonne compréhension des contraintes techniques liées à la production audiovisuelle, aux formats vidéo, aux codecs et à l’optimisation des exports. • Connaissance et pratique des outils d’IA générative image/vidéo (Midjourney, Runway, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion…). • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle, avec un bon sens du détail, de l’organisation et de la réactivité. • Esprit collaboratif et capacité à travailler efficacement avec les équipes de production, de montage et de post-production. • Bonne communication écrite et orale (FR/EN).
