jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Machine Learning
jobs.description: About Yassir: Yassir is the leading super app in the Maghreb region, set on changing the way daily services are provided. It currently operates in 45 cities across Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia, with recent expansions into France, Canada and Sub-Saharan Africa. It is backed (~$200M in funding) by VCs from Silicon Valley, Europe and other parts of the world. We offer on-demand services such as ride-hailing and last-mile delivery. Building on this infrastructure, we are now introducing financial services to help our users pay, save and borrow digitally. We're helping usher the continent into a digital economy era, not just by serving people, but by building a marketplace that brings people what they need while infusing social values. About the Role: Yassir's marketplace runs on decisions made millions of times a day: which driver gets which trip, what a ride should cost, when an order will arrive, which transaction looks fraudulent, who qualifies for credit. We are looking for a Product Manager who owns the machine learning systems behind those decisions and is accountable for their measurable impact on the business. This is a product role for ML-heavy, data-intensive products. You will lead discovery from data rather than from opinion, frame business problems as problems a model can actually solve, define what success means both offline and in production, and prove impact through well-designed experiments. You will work closely with data scientists, ML engineers and data engineers, and with product and operations partners across ride-hailing, delivery and financial services. What This Role Is (and Isn't) This role centres on predictive and decisioning ML: ranking, matching, forecasting, pricing, risk and personalisation. Experience building LLM or agentic features is welcome, but it is not a substitute for the fundamentals below. If your ML product experience is primarily integrating third-party models or APIs into user-facing features, this role is likely not the right fit. Responsibilities: Data-led discovery: Identify and size ML opportunities by going into the data yourself. Diagnose where the marketplace is losing value (supply-demand imbalance, cancellations, ETA error, fraud losses, default rates) and translate it into a prioritised, quantified problem backlog. Problem framing: Turn business problems into well-posed ML problems: define the prediction target, the decision it informs, the unit of analysis, label availability and quality, and the cost of different error types. Know when a problem does not need ML and a rule or heuristic will do. Metrics and success criteria: Define the chain from model metrics (e.g. precision/recall, calibration, MAE) to product and business metrics, and own guardrail metrics. Understand why offline gains often fail to translate online, and plan for it. Experimentation and causal inference: Design and interpret controlled experiments, including in two-sided marketplace settings where interference makes standard A/B tests unreliable (switchback, geo or cluster-randomised designs). Reason about statistical power, novelty effects and heterogeneous impact across cities and segments. Distinguish correlation from causation, and know which quasi-experimental methods to use when randomisation isn't possible. ML product lifecycle: Own models from framing through data requirements, baseline, iteration, launch, monitoring and retirement. Partner with engineering on rollout strategy, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining cadence and failure modes. Treat a model in production as a product that degrades if unattended. Roadmap and trade-offs: Own the ML product roadmap across domains and countries. Make explicit trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, interpretability, fairness and regulatory requirements, especially in credit and financial services. Stakeholder alignment and visibility: Make the impact of ML work legible to non-technical leadership. Communicate results, including null and negative results, with rigour and clarity. Align product, operations, risk and marketing partners on shared objectives. Leadership and culture: Raise the bar on how the organisation makes decisions with data. Mentor peers, build a culture of feedback and trust, and invest in your own growth and that of those around you. Requirements: 4+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning ML-driven products that run in production and influence core business decisions (e.g. pricing, matching, ranking, forecasting, fraud, credit risk, recommendations). Hands-on fluency with data: you can write SQL, explore data independently and challenge an analysis without waiting for someone else to run it. Demonstrated experience designing, running and interpreting controlled experiments, and a solid working understanding of causal inference. Strong understanding of core ML concepts: supervised learning, evaluation metrics and their trade-offs, overfitting and leakage, bias, calibration, and the relationship between offline and online performance. A track record of shipping ML products where you can clearly articulate the problem framing, the metrics chosen, the experiment design and the measured business impact, including what went wrong. Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple markets. Experience in marketplaces, mobility, on-demand delivery or fintech is a strong plus. BSc/MSc in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Agentic Developer
jobs.description: About Integrant For 34 years, Integrant has designed and delivered advanced, business solutions for U.S. enterprises in biotech, medical devices, manufacturing, finance, and related highly regulated industries. Our teams are experts in traditional web and mobile applications, AI/HPC infrastructure support, data engineering, predictive AI, machine learning, and Agentic solutions. We build long-term partnerships—two-thirds of our customers choosing to partner with us 5+ years—by solving mission-critical problems with rigor, empathy, and measurable outcomes. Role overview Title: Agentic Developer (Enterprise Agentic Systems) Mission: Build production-grade AI agents that run real business processes inside enterprise environments — reliably, securely, observably, and with measurable ROI. This is not a prompt-engineering or demo-building role. The person we hire owns the full lifecycle of an agent: design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. They treat an agent as a distributed software system with a probabilistic component, not as a chatbot with tools attached. Stack-agnostic by design. We use Python and TypeScript, and frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, and Copilot Studio appear in our work as examples, not requirements. We hire for the underlying engineering judgment: someone who can pick up any orchestration framework in a week because they understand what every framework is abstracting. Key responsibilities: 1. Agent design & orchestration Design single-agent and multi-agent systems: planner/executor, supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and event-driven patterns, choosing the simplest pattern that meets the requirement. Model agent workflows as explicit state machines or graphs with defined states, transitions, retries, timeouts, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Define tool contracts (schemas, idempotency, error semantics) and implement tool-calling with validation and graceful degradation. Implement memory strategies: short-term context management, long-term memory stores, and session persistence with clear retention rules. 2. Retrieval & knowledge (RAG at scale) Build and tune retrieval pipelines: chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, metadata filtering, and query rewriting. Handle enterprise document realities: permissions-aware retrieval, multi-tenant isolation, freshness and sync from source systems. Measure retrieval quality (recall, precision, groundedness) and fix it at the pipeline level, not the prompt level. 3. Evaluation, testing & quality Build eval suites before shipping: golden datasets, task-level success metrics, LLM-as-judge with calibration, regression tests on every change. Write unit and integration tests for tools, state transitions, and guardrails; test the non-LLM 80% like any other software. Run offline and online evals; use A/B or shadow deployments to validate changes against production traffic. 4. Observability & operations Instrument agents end-to-end: traces per run, token/cost accounting, latency per step, tool-call outcomes, and failure classification. Define SLOs for agents (success rate, p95 latency, cost per task) and build dashboards and alerts against them. Operate agents in production: on-call participation, incident analysis, root-cause on model and non-model failures. 5. Security, safety & governance Implement defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse; enforce least-privilege for every tool and integration. Apply input/output guardrails, PII handling, content policies, and audit logging that satisfies enterprise compliance. Design human-approval gates for high-impact actions and make agent decisions explainable to auditors and business owners. 6. Enterprise integration Integrate agents with ERP, CRM, ITSM, document management, and identity systems via APIs, event streams, and MCP-style tool servers. Handle authentication and authorization on behalf of users (OAuth, service principals, delegated access) correctly. Build agents that survive real data: inconsistent records, partial failures, rate limits, and legacy interfaces. 7. Delivery & collaboration Translate business processes into agent specifications with clear success criteria and ROI measures. Produce architecture decision records, runbooks, and handover documentation. Mentor engineers transitioning into agentic development; review designs and code for agent-specific pitfalls. Requirements Must-have 8+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 1–2 years shipping LLM-based systems to production users. Strong in Python or TypeScript, working proficiency in the other; comfortable with async programming, API design, and typed data models (e.g., Pydantic/Zod). Has built at least one agent that runs a real multi-step workflow with tool calls in production, and can describe its failure modes and how they were fixed. Hands-on with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and able to explain what it abstracts and when to drop to raw API calls. Practical RAG experience: vector and hybrid search, chunking strategy, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. Experience writing evals for LLM systems and treating prompt changes as code changes with regression coverage. Working knowledge of observability tooling (OpenTelemetry-style tracing, LLM tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or equivalent). Understanding of LLM security threats (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency) and standard mitigations. Experience integrating with enterprise systems through REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, or message queues, including auth flows (OAuth 2.0, service accounts). Experience with workflow engines (Temporal, or Durable Functions, or Step Functions) for long-running agent processes. Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or client implementation. Nice-to-have Cloud deployment experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with containers and CI/CD Fine-tuning or distillation experience, or structured-output and function-calling optimization at scale. Knowledge-graph or semantic-layer experience for grounding agents. Exposure to regulated environments (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and audit requirements. Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Coordinate KYC, account documentation, and other periodic compliance submissions requested by banks. 2. Cash & Liquidity Management Prepare and maintain short-term (daily/weekly) and medium-term cash flow forecasts across onshore and offshore entities, identifying surplus or deficit positions. Recommend and execute fund transfers, intercompany funding, cash pooling/sweeping, and short-term placement or borrowing to optimize liquidity and banking costs. Monitor working capital facility utilization and coordinate drawdowns and repayments with banks. 3. Trade Finance & Forex Execution Process and follow up on trade finance instruments – letters of credit, letters of guarantee, bill discounting and supplier financing – including issuance, amendments and bank coordination. Execute forex transactions (spot and forward) within approved limits and the Group's hedging policy; track forex exposures and rate movements. Support the maintenance and reporting of interest rate and forex risk positions. 4. Banking Relationship Management & Compliance Act as the primary day-to-day point of contact with onshore and offshore banking partners, ensuring queries and requirements are resolved promptly. Coordinate with internal departments (accounting, legal, commercial) to gather documentation required by banks. Monitor and comply with anti-fraud controls, treasury policies, and internal/external audit recommendations relating to banking operations. 5. Reporting & MIS Prepare periodic MIS, treasury dashboards, and debt/facility utilization reports for the CFO and senior management. Maintain accurate records supporting bank reconciliations, treasury controls, and audit requirements. 6. Strategic & Financing Support Support the CFO in structuring, reviewing and negotiating credit facilities, term sheets and legal/banking agreements with banks and lawyers. Assist in sourcing working capital and trade finance facilities from commercial banks, and provide supporting analysis for engagement with multilateral institutions (e.g. IFC, DEG, EBRD, FMO) where relevant. Contribute treasury data and analysis to financing proposals, board papers and debt reviews prepared by senior management. Key Interactions Internal: CFO, Finance & Accounting team, Group Banking. External: Banks, regulatory bodies, external/statutory auditors, tax advisors and consultants. Debt covenant compliance: 100% compliance, with 90–180 day forward covenant forecasting. Debt servicing & refinancing: 100% interest/principal paid on time; refinancing initiated well ahead of maturity. Cost of borrowing: Actual all-in funding cost vs approved benchmark/budget; measurable savings from repricing/refinancing. Cash-flow forecasting accuracy: 13-week forecast accuracy: ≥90–95%, particularly for first 4 weeks. Working-capital / cash release: Reduction in trapped/excess cash; measurable cash released through treasury initiatives. Cash visibility: ≥95–98% of group/country bank balances visible centrally daily. Banking efficiency: Reduce idle accounts, bank charges and transaction costs; annual savings target. Interest income on surplus cash: Return vs approved risk-free/low-risk benchmark while maintaining required liquidity. Treasury controls: Zero material control breaches; 100% bank reconciliations and authorized transactions. Banking relationships / facilities: Adequate committed facilities; diversification of lenders and no unexpected facility withdrawal. Legacy Data, Opening Balances & Financial Cleanup • Lead the controlled review and validation of opening balances and legacy accounting information transferred into the new finance environment. • Use original documents, reconciliations and reliable source evidence to validate financial data where historical systems or records cannot be fully relied upon. • Investigate significant differences and identify root causes before deciding whether correction, reconstruction or other action is required. • Document unresolved historical issues, financial risks and required corrective actions and escalate them appropriately. • Prevent unverified historical data from contaminating the integrity of the new accounting environment. 5. ERP & Finance Systems Development • Own Finance requirements and controls during the phased development of the ERP environment. • Ensure the General Ledger is stabilized before supporting controlled activation and integration of additional ERP modules. • Participate in ERP rehabilitation, data migration, mapping, testing, module activation and process-improvement projects. • Validate that new modules and interfaces integrate correctly with the General Ledger and do not create duplication, conflicting records or uncontrolled entries. • Ensure appropriate finance controls, approvals and audit trails are embedded in system implementation. 6. As a Graduate or Associate, you will support resilience assessments, business continuity and crisis management activities, and learn how organizations prepare for, respond to and recover from major disruptions. jobs.title: ETIC, CPS Project Manager - Manager
jobs.description: Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector Technology Specialism Advisory - Other Management Level Manager Job Description & Summary At PwC, our people in project portfolio management focus on optimising project portfolios to drive strategic business outcomes. These individuals oversee project selection, prioritisation, and resource allocation to facilitate successful project delivery. In project management at PwC, you will oversee and coordinate various projects to facilitate successful delivery within budget and timeline. You will leverage strong organisational and communication skills to effectively manage teams and stakeholders. About the Team The Capital Project Services (CPS) team is made up of skilled professionals with expertise in delivering capital projects across a variety of sectors, including Energy, Utilities, and Resource, Transport, Oil & Gas and Government & Healthcare. We help clients maximise the value of their projects and businesses by providing the knowledge and support needed to navigate complex and challenging situations. Role Overview As a CPS Manager, you will design and implement effective project and programme management strategies for clients across multiple industries. You will work closely with senior leaders of major global organisations to improve the efficiency of their capital programmes, support the achievement of project objectives, and provide guidance to clients managing projects within tight budget constraints. You will also assist clients in overcoming project delivery challenges. The role will be predominately focussed on the UK market, which you will typically support remotely from the ETIC. Candidates should be available to travel regionally and to the UK, although this will not be required regularly. Key Responsibilities • Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously, reporting to senior members of staff, both in ETIC and the UK. • Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members, providing training and guidance as required. • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, acting as a key point of contact. • Contribute to the technical development of both yourself and the wider team, ensuring up-to-date knowledge of industry best practices. • Stay informed about local and national business and economic trends relevant to capital projects. • Participate in business development activities, including identifying and researching new opportunities with existing and prospective clients. • Foster strong internal relationships and actively promote the CPS team’s capabilities within the firm. Types of Engagements you will work on: CPS assists clients with a broad range of challenges relating to their capital programmes. We are constantly adapting our approach to meet our clients needs and challenges. Some typical engagements are as follows: • Programme Recovery and Turnaround : Supporting a public sector client whose major infrastructure programme was facing significant delays and cost overruns. Conduct a comprehensive review, identify root causes, and implement a recovery plan to bring the programme back on track. • Capital Programme Optimisation : Work with a utility company to review and optimise their capital investment portfolio. This includes prioritising projects, streamlining governance processes, and introducing new performance management tools to maximise return on investment. • Digital Transformation of Project Controls : Assist a infrastructure asset owner in implementing digital project controls across their capital projects portfolio. Selecting and deploying new project management software, training staff, and embedding new ways of working to improve transparency and reporting. • Procurement and Supply Chain Strategy : Advising a utilities company on the development and execution of a new procurement and supply chain strategy for a multi-billion-pound capital programme. Support supplier selection, contract negotiations, and the establishment of robust commercial management processes. • Independent Project Assurance: Providing independent assurance to a client on the delivery of a major capital project. Including regular health checks, risk assessments, and recommendations to improve project governance and delivery confidence. Candidate Profile We are seeking a candidate who: • Communicates confidently and delivers clear, impactful messages to a range of audiences to influence outcomes. • Demonstrates leadership skills and a strong commitment to coaching and developing others. • Possesses strong technical and analytical abilities, with the capacity to simplify complex issues and deliver practical client solutions. • Is passionate about capital project delivery and motivated to learn from colleagues and build collaborative relationships at all levels. • Has a solid academic background and relevant industry experience, with a commitment to ongoing professional development. • Is willing to travel nationally and internationally as required. Experience and Skills The ideal candidate will have: • Experience working in asset management environments. • Proven ability to lead, manage, or work effectively within teams to deliver projects and solutions. • Strong relationship-building skills and self-motivation to achieve high-quality results. • Experience managing contracts, suppliers, or projects, with a thorough understanding of the core principles underpinning successful project delivery. • A commitment to continuous personal and team development. • Management consulting experience, including the design and implementation of operating and delivery models. • Experience in digital transformation or technology consulting. • Commercial experience in supply chain management, procurement, commercial management, or contract negotiations. jobs.title: ETIC, Cybersecurity - IDAM - Associate (German Speaker)
jobs.description: Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector Technology Specialism Advisory - Other Management Level Associate Job Description & Summary Practice Description: Our Digital Identity team helps organizations make sure the right people and systems have the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons.​ ​ We help clients answer practical questions such as: How should employees receive access when they join or change roles? How do we prevent excessive access? How can users sign in securely without creating unnecessary friction? And how should sensitive administrator access be protected?​ ​ As a Graduate or Associate, you will work hands-on with identity technologies, helping configure, integrate and test solutions while learning how identity processes work across complex organizations. Core Activities: “ What You’ll Be Working On” ​ Support identity lifecycle processes: Help configure how access is granted, changed and removed when employees join, move roles or leave the organization. ​ Improve secure access: Support authentication, Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication so users can access applications securely and efficiently. ​ Configure roles and permissions: Help define user roles, groups and access rights so employees receive the access they need without unnecessary privileges. ​ Connect applications to identity platforms: Support integrations between business applications, directories and identity systems such as Microsoft Entra ID. ​ Test whether solutions work: Execute functional and integration tests, investigate errors and document results and remediation actions. ​ Work with identity data: Analyze users, roles and permissions to identify inconsistencies, excessive access or provisioning issues. ​ Build technical foundations: Gain practical exposure to APIs, authentication protocols, scripting and cloud identity environments.​ Key Skills: “ What you need to have” ​ Typically 0–4 years of experience . Prior IAM experience is helpful, but not required.​ We are looking for people interested in how users, applications and technology interact. A background in computer science, information systems, engineering, cybersecurity or a related technical field is beneficial.​ You should be comfortable learning technical concepts, troubleshooting problems and working carefully with configurations and data. jobs.title: ETIC, Risk Officer Director
jobs.description: Line of Service Internal Firm Services Industry/Sector Technology Specialism IFS - Internal Firm Services - Other Management Level Director Job Description & Summary At PwC, our people in risk and compliance focus on maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice, and solutions. They help organisations navigate complex regulatory landscapes and enhance their internal controls to mitigate risks effectively. As a risk management generalist at PwC, you will provide advisory and practical support to teams across a wide range of specialist risk and compliance areas. As ETIC continues its rapid expansion as PwC’s acceleration and delivery center serving PwC shareholder firms across the region, the scale and complexity of operational, regulatory, cyber, continuity, and enterprise risks continue to evolve significantly. To support sustainable growth, governance, resilience, and compliance with PwC Network standards, ETIC requires a centralized and mature risk management function. The Director is responsible for leading and acting as the primary custodian of ETIC’s risk management framework and governance structure. The role oversees Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”), Business Continuity Management (“BCM”), Business Resilience, Network Information Security (“NIS”), Data Privacy, and oversight of Ethics & Compliance activities delivered in coordination with the PwC Middle East firm. The role is responsible for maintaining ETIC’s enterprise risk register, proactively identifying and assessing risks across the organization, driving mitigation and remediation plans with business and delivery stakeholders, and ensuring alignment with PwC governance standards and shareholder firm expectations. At Director level, the role sets and operationalizes ETIC’s risk appetite and tolerance, advises leadership on material risk trade-offs, provides forward-looking risk insight to enable sustainable growth, and shapes strategic decision-making beyond baseline compliance. The Director works closely with ETIC leadership, business functions, delivery teams, and shareholder risk functions to strengthen ETIC’s control environment, resilience capabilities, and risk culture while promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement. Primary duties and responsibilities Financial • Operate within ETIC’s budget and plan, ensuring proportionate investment in risk management and resilience. • Supports efficient risk and control management practices to minimize operational and regulatory exposure. KPIs Enterprise Risk Management • Own and maintain ETIC’s enterprise risk management framework and risk governance structure. • Own the design, periodic refresh and operationalisation of ETIC’s Risk Appetite Framework, translating appetite and tolerance into clear decision thresholds, limits and escalation triggers for leadership and governance forums. • Act as the custodian of ETIC’s enterprise risk register, ensuring periodic review, update, and reporting. • Work closely with business and delivery functions to identify operational, strategic, technology, regulatory, and people-related risks ensuring risks are clearly articulated, owned and monitored. • Ensure appropriate mitigation actions, ownership, timelines, and monitoring mechanisms are implemented for identified risks. • Deliver a disciplined risk reporting suite (e.g., quarterly risk profile and top-risk movements, appetite position, key incidents/themes, resilience testing outcomes and remediation status) to support timely, informed governance decisions. • Promote a strong risk culture and risk awareness consultation, escalation and accountability across ETIC. Business Continuity & Resilience • Lead the development, implementation, maintenance, and periodic testing of ETIC’s Business Continuity Plan (“BCP”) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DR) • Oversee business continuity exercises, scenario testing, crisis simulations, and remediation activities ensuring learning is embedded and tracked to closure. • Lead ETIC’s business resilience program to ensure operational resilience and recovery readiness at scale. • Coordinate crisis management and incident response governance processes where required ensuring clear escalation, decision-making and communications discipline. Information Security & NIS • Oversee ETIC’s Network Information Security (“NIS”) function and cyber risk management activities. • Work closely with the NIS/CISO lead to ensure compliance with PwC Network security standards and regulatory requirements. • Monitor cybersecurity risks, controls, vulnerabilities, incidents, and remediation activities. • Ensure effective governance and oversight of information security policies, standards, and awareness initiatives. Data Privacy • Oversee ETIC’s data privacy framework and governance activities. • Work closely with the DPO to ensure compliance with applicable privacy laws, regulations, and PwC Network standards. • Monitor privacy risks, incidents, assessments, and remediation activities ensuring appropriate escalation and sustained control effectiveness. • Ensure privacy-by-design principles are embedded into ETIC operations and processes. Ethics & Compliance Oversight • Provide oversight and coordination support for Ethics & Compliance activities delivered by the PwC Middle East firm. • Ensure ETIC management is appropriately informed of compliance risks, investigations, and remediation activities with clear escalation where required. • Coordinate with shareholder firms and relevant stakeholders on governance and compliance matters ensuring alignment of expectations and decision support. Internal Process • Develop, implement, and maintain ETIC risk management policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks. • Establish effective risk reporting, monitoring, escalation, and issue management processes with clear artefacts and accountability. • Define and maintain clear accountability between first-line operational owners, risk oversight and escalation, and audit/assurance interfaces—ensuring effective challenge, evidence-based control monitoring and audit-readiness. • Ensure alignment with any applicable PwC Network standards, policies, and governance requirements. • Review and enhance internal controls and operational processes to improve and strengthen risk management effectiveness and reduce control gaps. • Support internal and external audits, assessments, and regulatory reviews where applicable ensuring evidence quality and timely remediation. • Maintain strong collaboration with shareholder firm risk functions to align on best practices, governance expectations, and risk initiatives. Learning & Growth • Build strong relationships with ETIC leadership, business stakeholders, and shareholder firms to enable constructive risk leadership and timely decisions.. • Promote a culture of accountability, resilience, compliance, and continuous improvement. • Lead, mentor, and develop direct reports and broader risk function capabilities. • Contribute to cross-functional collaboration and organizational effectiveness. • Stay informed on emerging risks, regulatory developments, cybersecurity threats, and industry best practices. Job Requirement Education • A professional or academic qualification (degree level or equivalent), or extensive relevant and practical experience. • Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Information Security, Law, Finance, or related field. • Professional certifications such as CRISC, CISM, CISSP, ISO 22301, ISO 27001, GDPR/Data Privacy, or equivalent are preferred. Language • Bilingual Arabic-English (with strong English). Overall Experience • 13+ years of relevant experience. jobs.title: ETIC, Resource Manager Operations – Senior Associate
jobs.description: Line of Service Advisory Industry/Sector Technology Specialism Advisory - Other Management Level Senior Associate Job Description & Summary The Resource Management Operation Specialist team delivers end-to-end analytics solutions across a wide range of internal data domains, covering resource management, data ingestion and transformation through to dashboard and analytics consumption, with the people data domain being a key area of focus. While end-user outputs include dashboards and ad-hoc analytics, these are underpinned by centrally managed production data pipelines and curated data assets. The team builds and maintains these centrally owned assets for use across the business, ensuring solutions are consistent, reusable, and straightforward to support over time. As part of the Resource Management Operation Specialist, the candidate will need to be focused on back-end data engineering and data model design, contributing to the development and operation of production data pipelines and data assets. Work is delivered primarily in Databricks using PySpark and Spark SQL, with a strong emphasis on quality, reusability, and long-term sustainability. Scope of responsibility The role will be responsible for the following activities: Resource Management Operation Stakeholder management, communication, and organization Designing and evolving data models and pipeline architectures that support analytics and reporting use cases. Building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines in Databricks using PySpark and Spark SQL. Supporting production data pipelines by investigating data defects or failures when raised, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Translating problem statements and reporting needs into well-structured data solutions, operating with minimal guidance. Working with the internal team and, where appropriate, business stakeholders to clarify data requirements from a data model and engineering perspective. Championing well-designed, consistent data models that enable reliable downstream analytics and reduce duplication. Contributing to shared engineering standards through code review, reusable utilities, and common design patterns Producing clear code-level documentation and contributing to shared technical documentation to support knowledge transfer and long-term maintainability. Managing code in Git-based version-controlled environments. Required technical capability The role requires strong, hands-on experience in: Resource Management Data engineering using Databricks, with practical experience in PySpark and Spark SQL. Designing data models optimised for analytics and reporting consumption. Building, operating, and improving production data pipelines in an enterprise environment. Using Git for version control, including managing branches, pull requests, and participating in code reviews. Writing and maintaining clear, well-structured code suitable for long-term ownership and reuse. Broader Python development to support data engineering workflows beyond core transformations. Working alongside downstream analytics tools such as Power BI, with sufficient understanding to ensure data models support efficient consumption (without owning dashboard or semantic model development). jobs.description: Chez Konecta, nous recrutons des talents engagés et passionnés Vous aimez le concret, résoudre des problèmes pratiques et apporter des solutions utiles aux clients ? Chez Konecta Chalon-sur-Saône (71) , nous recherchons des personnes qui aiment comprendre les demandes, trouver des solutions et accompagner les clients au quotidien. Qui est notre client ? Notre client, spécialiste de la gestion de l’eau, des déchets et de l’énergie, accompagne ses clients dans le suivi de leurs dossiers, en leur apportant conseils et solutions afin de garantir leur satisfaction.. Vos missions au quotidien Répondre aux demandes des clients avec écoute, clarté et précision Traiter différentes demandes administratives et de gestion Transmettre les informations aux bons interlocuteurs Veiller à apporter une réponse adaptée et garantir une expérience client de qualité Exemples de demandes traitées Facturation Changement de RIB et gestion des prélèvements Souscription, résiliation et relevé d’index (sans vente ni démarchage commercial) Gestion des fuites d’eau Traitement des factures impayées Vos avantages Mutuelle prise en charge à 50 % par l'employeur. Titre restaurant (Carte restaurant): 7,80 € par jour (pris en charge à 60 %). Participation aux frais de transport à hauteur de 75%. Comité Qualité Vie des Conditions au Travail (QVCT) dédié à l'amélioration des conditions de travail. Indemnité de télétravail Promotion interne : 100% de notre équipe encadrante est issue du poste conseiller relation client. Conditions de travail Amplitude horaire : Planning communiqué 5 semaines à l’avance pour vous permettre de mieux vous organiser. Le service client est ouvert du lundi au vendredi, sur des horaires pouvant varier entre 08h00 et 19h00. Le samedi de 09h00 à 12h00, selon un roulement Contrat de 36 heures par semaine, avec deux jours de repos hebdomadaires et des RTT Salaire : 1 867,06 € brut mensuel + primes Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un contrat au sein d’un groupe reconnu, dans un environnement dynamique et bienveillant. Une formation complète de 6 jours pour développer vos compétences et prendre confiance dans votre nouveau métier. Un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de votre intégration. Un métier utile et varié, où chaque journée est différente et où le travail d’équipe a toute sa place. De réelles perspectives d’évolution pour construire votre avenir professionnel. Profil recherché Nous recherchons des personnes qui possèdent : Un excellent sens du service client. De l'empathie et de la bienveillance. De la rigueur et une bonne organisation. Un esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques. Une bonne autonomie. Un véritable esprit d'équipe. Un bon niveau d'orthographe et une bonne expression orale. Une première expérience dans la relation client, l'assistance ou les assurances est un plus, mais votre motivation fera avant tout la différence. Processus de recrutement Candidature à l'offre Tests de recrutement Information collective et entretien Entretien Rejoignez Konecta et contribuez chaque jour à accompagner des clients dans des moments importants, grâce à votre sens du service et votre engagement. #konecta_recrute Konecta s’engage en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion. Coordonner la préparation des liasses de consolidation, des reportings et des indicateurs financiers destinés au Groupe. Développer l’automatisation des processus pour fiabiliser les données, réduire les délais et permettre aux équipes de se concentrer sur l’analyse. Contribuer à l’intégration de nouvelles technologies, notamment de l’intelligence artificielle, dans les processus financiers. jobs.title: WandDo Shop - Careers
jobs.description: Head of Marketing | FabMinds Home WandDo Features Pre-Order Pricing Careers Join Our Team About Who We Are Our Values Inside FabMinds Contact Us Menu Home WandDo Features Pre-Order Pricing Careers Join Our Team About Who We Are Our Values Inside FabMinds Contact Us WandDo Shop - Careers a product by Fab-Minds Inc Head of Marketing Marketing, Cairo, Egypt WandDo is a Cairo-based e-commerce brand built on a single idea: what you own should be made for you. Not chosen from a catalog, made for you, your name, your moment. We produce personalized products on demand from our own network of industrial 3D printers: desk accessories, home décor, lighting, and corporate gifts today. Personalized furniture, IoT gadgets, and categories that don't exist yet tomorrow. The technology isn't the product. It's the platform for an idea. WandDo is powered by FabMinds, a company building an AI-powered manufacturing platform that WandDo directly powers and proves. Every order, every preference, every demand signal feeds into it. This isn't just a consumer brand: it's the proof of concept for a new category of manufacturing. This is a senior marketing leadership role with two simultaneous mandates. Scale our strong and growing paid-media-driven revenue, doubling and tripling it with better ROAS. And build the kind of brand that earns its own gravity, where people seek WandDo out, share it, and buy from it because they believe in it, not because an ad found them. This role reports to the VP of Marketing & Business Development. This is a performance-based role. You will own WandDo's monthly revenue and growth number, judged on results. We are looking for someone who has already delivered at this scale: a proven track record of leading marketing for a recognized local brand, with real personal accountability for a revenue number. Gulf experience (KSA, UAE) is a strong plus. Roles & Responsibilities Performance Marketing Oversight: Own the results of the paid media function, not by running it personally, but by setting the strategy that drives it. Define the creative direction, offer logic, and ROAS standards the team executes against. Build a culture of rapid, hypothesis-driven testing across Meta, TikTok, and other active channels. Challenge what isn't working. Double down on what is. Brand Story & Identity: Define the single narrative that makes WandDo impossible to confuse with any other brand. Not a tagline: the founding truth of why this brand exists, what it stands against (mass production, generic ownership), and what it stands for. Every category WandDo enters, today's accessories, tomorrow's furniture, the IoT gadgets after that, must feel like the natural next expression of one idea. Consumer Research & Product Ideation: Be the company's most reliable source of what to build next. Go beyond analytics: talk to customers, track what people complain about, study what they customize themselves, watch adjacent categories. Bring concrete product ideas to the team with a clear case for why the demand is real and the timing is right. Earned Media & Organic Growth Engine: Build the systems that make customers share, creators post, and press write, without being paid to. The personalization reveal moment, the unboxing experience, the UGC strategy, PR hooks, and the community layer that turns buyers into advocates. Paid ads run the engine today. This responsibility is about building the flywheel that makes it lighter over time. Customer Psychology & Positioning: Own a deep understanding of why each buyer segment actually buys: self-purchase (identity), gifting (what it says about the giver), corporate (status, reciprocity). Ensure this informs every creative decision and message across both paid and organic channels. Content & Creative Direction: Write or directly brief every ad hook, script, and piece of on-site copy. Direct the creative team's output around a stated psychological or brand angle, not just aesthetics. Own on-site conversion rate, including the live personalization preview, the most direct expression of the brand's core promise. Offer & Pricing Strategy: Own bundling, pricing logic, and occasion-based offers (Eid, Mother's Day, back-to-school). Every offer must be rooted in the customer's psychology and the brand's story, not reactive discounting that trains buyers to wait for sales and quietly erodes what the brand stands for. Retention & Community: Own the post-purchase relationship through WhatsApp-led CRM. Build the system that treats every customer as a potential advocate, a repeat buyer at the next life moment, and a referral source. Team Leadership: Directly manage: media buyer, performance marketer, content creator(s), and a CRM/retention specialist. Set direction, develop capability, and hold the team accountable for output, not hours. Requirements 7+ years in marketing with a proven track record of personally owning a revenue number for a recognized local brand: real accountability for the result, not just the activity. Deep understanding of paid media (Meta, TikTok, performance fundamentals) sufficient to set strategy and know when numbers are being gamed. Proven experience building a brand with genuine organic pull: a following, a community, or earned media that didn't need budget to sustain. Gulf market experience (KSA, UAE) is a strong plus. Proven background in D2C or e-commerce in Egypt or a similar market, where cash-on-delivery is the norm and WhatsApp is where most customer questions and confirmations actually happen. Fluency in direct-response storytelling and consumer psychology: understanding not just which message converts, but why. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a small, high-output team (3 to 5 people) directly. Working fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken. Desired Candidate Qualities Can run a paid media function and build a brand simultaneously, and understands they are not in conflict: just different time horizons. Explains why a campaign won in terms of what the customer actually wanted, not just which version had a better CTR. Sees WandDo not as a gifting brand or a 3D printing company, but as the brand that owns personalization, and can articulate what that means for every category it enters next. Doesn't wait for the product team to hand them something to sell. Comes back with a customer insight, a market gap, and a reason the timing is right. Has killed a short-term tactic: not because it didn't convert, but because it was quietly damaging something more valuable. Comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage company: real constraints, decisions made in days not quarters. What We Offer Full ownership of a live, fast-growing consumer brand at a stage where the story is still being written: this role shapes what WandDo becomes. A reporting line to the VP of Marketing & Business Development, with direct access to the CEO and genuine influence over the company's direction. Compensation built around performance: competitive base salary plus a significant bonus tied directly to monthly revenue and growth targets. A clear growth path toward VP of Marketing or an expanded regional leadership position as WandDo scales into new markets and categories. Visibility into a broader AI-powered manufacturing platform that WandDo's customer data feeds directly into: this role matters well beyond the brand itself. Opportunities for growth through a wide spectrum of challenging assignments. Respectful workplace with a strong and diverse culture that encourages innovation and endorses equality. Continuous development through interaction and mentoring from skilled managers and peers, as well as formal training. Endorsement of employees' health and wellness as well as work-life balance. Join our team! Apply Now! Apply for this Job © 2026 FabMinds Company About Contact Us Careers Product Features Pricing Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions

Product Designer & 3D Modelling Specialist Creativity & Modelling Team, Cairo, Egypt Job Description Fab-Minds is looking for a 3D Modelling Specialist to develop, upgrade, and maintain the diverse and advanced 3D Modelling Libraries that is part of Fab-Minds' Products Bundle. The job will include the development of highly innovative and creative 3D Modelling solutions that form complete product libraries that should be available for purchase or download on our different platforms such as our mobile apps, web interfaces and our desktop solutions. The job will include interaction with other engineering functions inside the company both in-site and overseas to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions that meet our needs. To be successful in this role, you must be able to engage in initial stages of the definition and development of different 3D Modelling Libraries and to participate in the support and maintenance of already available and deployed Libraries. You must also be able to interact and manage the communication with different technical and non-technical stakeholders and formulate their requirements into functional requirements and eventually into creative product designs. Roles and Responsibilities: Use modeling software, creativity and artistic skill to create, maintain, and update 3D models. Create funtional products from verbal descriptions or reference images. Prototype and iterate on graphics, models and characters based on feedback from team members. Research upcoming projects to help find new ways to create designs or products. This sometimes includes developing storyboards to map out how scenes will look. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, to conceive new model concepts through brainstorming, solo thinking, and rough design prototyping. Develop products concepts through drawing, modeling, and digital renderings. Contribute to product invention efforts. Contribute to application concept development, branding, graphic design, package design, marketing, consumer analysis, and presentation. Troubleshoot problems on reintegration of outsourced assets into the 3D arts. Keep up with the latest developments in 3D design, 3D printing, modeling tools, AI and technologies. Education: BSc/MSc in Product Design, Manufacturing Design Engineering, Architecture, or relevant field. Deep knowledge and mastering of 3D modelling and product design. Knowledge of 3D printing led education is a plus. A good portfolio and technical skills are also necessary. Job Requirements: 2-4 years of experience with 3D design and modeling applications such as Autodesk Fusion, Blender, Rhinoceros 3D or similar modeling software. Extensive knowledge of character and model design. Ability to take feedback and make changes as required. Updated portfolio of previous work. Previous experience with physical toy design and can build interactive educational 3D models. Previous experience with 3D printers is a plus. Knowledge of 3D printing technologies is a plus. Proficiency in graphic, photo, and video editing using the Adobe Suite is a plus. Desired Candidate Qualities: Initiative-taking and willing to learn. Collaborative individual with strong problem-solving abilities. Self-driven with a sense of ownership and the ability to lead. Has the ability to brainstorm innovative ideas on a regular basis and strategize ways to stand out from the competition. Should have an aptitude for art and creativity. Should have the talent for art and a strong understanding of color, texture, and light, and how these elements work together. What we offer: Opportunities for growth through a wide spectrum of challenging assignments. Competitive compensation package and benefits in line with qualifications and experience. Respectful workplace with strong and diverse culture that encourages innovation and endorse equality. Continuous development of your skills through interaction and mentoring from highly skilled manager and peers as well as formal technical and non-technical trainings.
